correctness.summary: A direct diameter-two edge count gives the exact polynomial for the Szeged-Wiener gap. The equality equation is then solved exhaustively under the exact 2-connectivity constraints; a separate definition-level computation verifies the formula and classification over a finite parameter range.

limitations: The global equality classification remains open.
The theorem assumes a co-bipartition with one clique of size two.
The finite computation is supporting evidence only; the theorem is proved symbolically.
Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with recent or unindexed parallel work as residual risk.
Independent audit has not been performed.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The newly posted Zhang-Li paper proves the 2n bound, poses equality classification as an open problem, and gives one sufficient family while noting unspecified counterexamples. The directly relevant 2017 paper and older bounds were checked, and exact/synonymous searches found no formula or classification for the co-bipartite two-vertex-side subclass.

prior_scientific_assessment.review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.

value.summary: The result gives an exact invariant formula on a natural infinite dense class, proves uniqueness of the known equality family for all n >= 11 within that class, and isolates a unique additional ten-vertex equality type.
